title: NumPy 2.0.0 released
text: The first NumPy major release since 2006 introduced an ABI break.

evidence.excerpt: The release notes identify an ABI break.

evidence_reason: Official NumPy news and release notes establish the date and compatibility boundary.

title: pandas 2.2.2 declared NumPy 2.0 compatibility
text: The release notes say pandas 2.2.2 wheels work with NumPy 1.x and 2.x. This is readiness evidence, not observed adoption.

evidence.excerpt: pandas 2.2.2 is generally compatible with NumPy 2.0.

evidence_reason: Official pandas release notes directly declare compatibility before the NumPy release.

title: Arrow CI began resolving NumPy 2.0 as latest
text: The issue reports that most CI jobs default to the latest NumPy and proposes explicit NumPy 1.x coverage.

evidence.excerpt: NumPy 2.0 was released and most CI jobs default to NumPy's latest version.

evidence_reason: The downstream issue explicitly links default CI dependency resolution to the 2.0 release.

title: pandas 2.0.3 failed to import with NumPy 2.0
text: The report reproduces a dtype-size binary incompatibility after installing NumPy 2.0.

evidence.excerpt: pandas 2.0.3 with NumPy 2.0 raises numpy.dtype size changed.

evidence_reason: The downstream issue provides exact package versions and a reproducible import failure.

title: Maintainer recommended pandas 2.2.2 or NumPy below 2
text: The issue resolution directs affected users to a compatible pandas release or a temporary NumPy constraint.

evidence.excerpt: Use pandas 2.2.2 or pin numpy<2 for older pandas.

evidence_reason: The maintainer response records both an upgrade path and a temporary version constraint.

title: Pydantic 2.0 released
text: Pydantic announced the final 2.0 release and its new validation core and APIs.
evidence_reason: The official announcement and immutable package page establish the release boundary.

title: FastAPI 0.100.0 added Pydantic 2 support
text: FastAPI release notes state that tests run against both Pydantic 1 and 2.

evidence.excerpt: Add support for Pydantic v2 while keeping support for Pydantic v1.

evidence_reason: Official downstream release notes explicitly describe dual-version support and tests.

title: Prefect tracked a complex Pydantic 2 migration
text: The issue records import failures with Pydantic 2 and describes the migration as more than a dependency bump.

evidence.excerpt: Prefect uses Pydantic v1 and must migrate before accepting v2.

evidence_reason: The downstream migration issue identifies the failing import and the required migration work.

title: Prefect constrained Pydantic below 2
text: The pull request changed the dependency to pydantic>=1.10.0,<2.0.0.

evidence.excerpt: Pin pydantic to v1 for now.

evidence_reason: The merged downstream pull request contains the exact temporary dependency constraint.

title: FastAPI user hit a Pydantic 2.1.0 compatibility failure
text: The report shows FastAPI 0.100.0 failing with Pydantic 2.1.0 and notes the upstream 2.1.1 fix.

evidence.excerpt: FastAPI 0.100.0 with Pydantic 2.1.0 raises an AttributeError.

evidence_reason: A downstream user report identifies exact versions, but it is not a population measure.

title: FastAPI 0.101.0 excluded broken Pydantic 2.1.0
text: FastAPI adjusted its compatibility range and tests after the Pydantic 2.1.0 regression.

evidence.excerpt: Fix tests for Pydantic 2.1.1 and exclude Pydantic 2.1.0.

evidence_reason: Official FastAPI release notes record the concrete downstream compatibility correction.

title: SQLAlchemy 2.0.0 released
text: The major release completed a migration path staged through SQLAlchemy 1.4.
evidence_reason: The official changelog provides the release date and change record.

title: pandas 1.5.3 failed with SQLAlchemy 2.0
text: The report shows read_sql failing because OptionEngine no longer has execute, with downgrade to 1.4.46 as workaround.

evidence.excerpt: SQLAlchemy 2.0.0 causes an OptionEngine execute failure in pandas 1.5.3.

evidence_reason: The issue records exact versions, stack trace, regression boundary, and workaround.

title: pandas merged SQLAlchemy 2.0 compatibility work
text: The pull request updated pandas SQL code and reports tests against SQLAlchemy 2.0.0.
evidence_reason: The merged downstream pull request directly implements and tests compatibility.

title: pandas 2.0.0 shipped SQLAlchemy 2.0 support
text: This is one qualifying recovery event for the declared two-project cohort.
evidence_reason: Official pandas release notes explicitly state that compatibility shipped in a release.

title: Flask-SQLAlchemy merged 2.0 DeclarativeBase support
text: The pull request added model_class support for SQLAlchemy 2.0 style declarative bases.
evidence_reason: The merged downstream pull request implements a named SQLAlchemy 2.0 API path.

title: Flask-SQLAlchemy 3.1.0 shipped SQLAlchemy 2.x support
text: This is the second qualifying recovery event for the declared two-project cohort.

evidence.excerpt: Version 3.1.0 supports SQLAlchemy 2.x declarative base customization.

evidence_reason: The downstream changelog records support, but the cohort remains purposively selected.
